title: Parametric Rates for Nonparametric Conditional-Moment Bilevel Optimization
abstract:
arXiv:2605.21341v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study functional bilevel optimization with conditional moments, where plug-in hypergradients can inherit first-order errors from nonparametrically learned conditional expectations. We introduce OBiGrad, an orthogonalized hypergradient estimator whose bias is a product of nuisance errors. Under our regression and complexity conditions, projected gradient descent with the direct plug-in hypergradient yields expected stationarity error $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2}+n^{-
u/b})$ for the best iterate, whereas OBiGrad achieves $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2}+n^{-2
u/b})$, where $b=
u(2+p)+\gamma$ combines the approximation and complexity exponents. Consequently, when $
u(2-p)\ge\gamma$, OBiGrad attains the parametric statistical rate $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2})$, improving the sufficient sample-size bound relative to the direct plug-in bound for a fixed iteration budget. We illustrate these gains on instrumental-variable and fitted-Q-regression problems, exam

translated_title: 非参数条件矩双层优化的参数化速率
translated_abstract:
我们研究带有条件矩的函数式双层优化问题，其中插件式超梯度会从非参数学习的条件期望中继承一阶误差。我们提出了 OBiGrad，一种正交化的超梯度估计器，其偏差是滋扰误差的乘积。在我们的回归与复杂度条件下，使用直接插件式超梯度的投影梯度下降法在最佳迭代点上产生期望平稳性误差 $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2}+n^{-
u/b})$，而 OBiGrad 则达到 $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2}+n^{-2
u/b})$，其中 $b=
u(2+p)+\gamma$ 综合了逼近指数和复杂度指数。因此，当 $
u(2-p)\ge\gamma$ 时，OBiGrad 达到参数化统计速率 $O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2})$，在固定迭代预算下，相比直接插件式方法改进了充分样本量界限。我们在工具变量回归和拟合Q回归问题上展示了这些改进效果。
tldr: 该论文提出正交化超梯度估计器 OBiGrad，将超梯度偏差降低为滋扰误差的乘积，使条件矩双层优化达到参数化统计速率 O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2})，并在固定迭代预算下显著降低了所需的样本量界限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OBiGrad, an orthogonalized hypergradient estimator whose bias is a product of nuisance errors, enabling conditional-moment bilevel optimization to achieve the parametric statistical rate O(T^{-1/2}+n^{-1/2}) and improving sufficient sample-size bounds over direct plug-in methods under a fixed iteration budget.
